APP TYPE: chess_game
APP DESCRIPTION: Complete chess with move generation, check/checkmate detection, and minimax AI — Full chess implementation with FEN/PGN parsing, all legal move generation (including castling, en passant, promotion), check/checkmate/stalemate detection, and minimax with alpha-beta pruning AI
TARGET STACK: frontend=React, backend=Node.js Express, database=SQLite
SOURCE LANGUAGE: typescript

ARCHITECTURE CHECKLIST (the whole app is exactly these modules, each implemented in its own file):
  - Chess Input
  - Move Generator
  - Game Rules Engine
  - Board State
  - AI Engine
  - Board Renderer

WIRING GRAPH (data contracts between sibling modules — use these names verbatim so files connect):
  - Chess Input → Move Generator : requests
  - Move Generator → Game Rules Engine : results
  - Game Rules Engine → Board State : state_and_events
  - Board State → AI Engine : data
  - AI Engine → Board Renderer : updates

RULE: You are generating ONE module of this app. Implement exactly the module named in THIS FILE'S MODULE below.
Do NOT implement other checklist modules — they are separate files. Do NOT invent new modules.
